Exercises the Payments & Commerce section added 2026-11-04: Stripe + Adyen company news, agentic commerce, a payment-methods stat, and a Visa story deliberately duplicated in Business & Markets (it should be written ONCE, under PAYMENTS & COMMERCE). AI & Tech.title: Lab releases open-weight coding model that tops internal benchmarks
AI & Tech.description: An AI lab released an open-weight coding model on Tuesday. The company said it beat its previous model by 12 points on its internal coding benchmark and is free for commercial use.

AI & Tech.title: Chipmaker unveils inference accelerator with 2x memory bandwidth
AI & Tech.description: A chipmaker announced a data-center inference accelerator with twice the memory bandwidth of its prior generation, shipping to cloud customers in the first quarter.

Business & Markets.title: Stocks edge higher as Treasury yields slip ahead of jobs report
Business & Markets.description: The S&P 500 rose 0.4% on Tuesday as the 10-year Treasury yield fell to 4.1%. Investors are awaiting Friday's jobs report.

Business & Markets.title: Visa beats quarterly estimates on cross-border volume
Business & Markets.description: Visa reported fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of $10.9 billion, above analyst estimates, as cross-border volume grew 13%. The company said tokenized transactions rose 40% year over year.

Companies.title: Retailer cuts 1,200 corporate jobs in restructuring
Companies.description: A large US retailer said it will cut 1,200 corporate roles as part of a restructuring aimed at saving $400 million a year.

Companies.title: Streaming service raises ad-tier price by $2
Companies.description: A streaming service said its ad-supported tier will rise to $9.99 a month starting December 1.

Payments & Commerce.title: Stripe launches agent payments toolkit letting AI assistants check out on behalf of users
Payments & Commerce.description: Stripe on Tuesday released a toolkit that lets developers give AI agents single-use payment credentials scoped to a merchant and a spending limit. Stripe said 300 businesses tested it in beta.

Payments & Commerce.title: Adyen third-quarter net revenue rises 21% to EUR 620 million
Payments & Commerce.description: Adyen reported third-quarter net revenue of EUR 620 million, up 21% from a year earlier, on processed volume of EUR 370 billion. The company reiterated its medium-term growth target.

Payments & Commerce.title: Visa beats quarterly estimates on cross-border volume
Payments & Commerce.description: Visa reported fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of $10.9 billion, above analyst estimates, as cross-border volume grew 13%. The company said tokenized transactions rose 40% year over year.

Payments & Commerce.title: Bank group says account-to-account payments reached 8% of US e-commerce checkouts
Payments & Commerce.description: A payments industry group said account-to-account (pay-by-bank) payments made up 8% of US e-commerce checkouts in the third quarter, up from 5% a year earlier.
